summary: Back in the day, I and my friends believed that holding B reduced wild encounter. This mod makes the urban legend real. Hold the B and the encounter rate can be either reduced or stopped entirely. You can also make the encounter reaction-based so that you can shake off the Pokemon by pressing B if you manage to press it fast enough.

title: Professor Oak's Pokemon Appraisal
creator: zyrancz
summary: Let's you ask Professor Oak for DV/STAT Evaluation either directly in the PokePC or personally in Pallet Town.

title: Special Stat Split
creator: zyrancz
summary: Splits the simple SPECIAL into two SPATK and SPDEF as it was from GEN II onward. Also splits the MOVEs themselves as GEN IV onwards.

title: STEEL/FAIRY AND TYPING CHARTS
creator: zyrancz
summary: Adds newer types to the game: Fairy, Steel and Dark. Compatible now with Crystal 251 Mod. Can also change WEAK/RESIST Charts between Vanilla, GEN II and GEN VI

title: Tap to Move
creator: zyrancz
summary: You can now Tap to Move, the game hhas functional pathfinding and functional interactions. To avoid unwanted interactions midway, interactions are limited to only actually single tapping the object/npc, so that you can Hold Touch and keep moving.

title: Trainers Let You Choose Lead Pokemon
creator: zyrancz
summary: Trainers Let You Choose Lead Pokemon, you don't have to always send out the first one in the party
